$schema_note: Machine-readable extraction of console/tailwind.config.js and console/app/styles/*.css as of 2026-07-29. Descriptive snapshot of the CURRENT state, not a prescriptive spec. Regenerate by re-reading source rather than hand-editing when the app changes.

darkMode.note: Does NOT use prefers-color-scheme anywhere; dark mode is a user choice only, not automatic.

colors.note: brand color is 'lipu' (600 = #D0DF00, the signature yellow-green). 'sky', 'nightsky', 'night', 'midnight', 'moregray' are dark-mode-oriented gray/blue-black ramps used inconsistently across screens — no documented rule for when to use 'night' vs 'midnight' vs Tailwind's stock 'gray'.

borderRadius.note: No borderRadius key in tailwind.config.js theme.extend — components use Tailwind's default scale directly (rounded, rounded-md, rounded-lg, rounded-xl, rounded-full observed in real component markup).

spacing.note: theme.extend.spacing (tailwind.config.js:122-143) re-declares Tailwind's own default scale for keys 6-72 (no-op) and adds 74/78/82/86 duplicating the same values already added under theme.extend.width. Effectively only 5 real custom sizes exist, and they are also usable as width utilities.

fontFamily.inconsistency: Two different font families are hardcoded with !important in different stylesheets (Roboto in lipu.css, Inter in lipu-management.css). Neither is applied through the Tailwind 'roboto' family key consistently. This is a known inconsistency, not an intentional two-font system — see foundations.md Typography section.

typeScale.note: No named font-size/line-height/font-weight scale exists. Sizes are hardcoded inline with !important per rule. Representative samples (not exhaustive): 10px, 12px, 14px, 16px, 18px font-size and 500, 600 font-weight values coexist across lipu.css and lipu-management.css with no shared token.

breakpoints.note: No screens key in theme.extend — Tailwind defaults (sm 640px, md 768px, lg 1024px, xl 1280px, 2xl 1536px) are used as-is.
breakpoints.reading: Responsive design is applied selectively (auth pages, a handful of dashboard/grid layouts), not systematically. The bulk of dense operational screens (monitoring, routes, planning tables) show no responsive prefixes — built fixed-width/desktop-only, consistent with an internal ops tool.

zIndex.note: No zIndex key in theme.extend. No shared scale or constants are enforced in practice, despite one unused utility (see 'deadCode' below).

informalTiers.note: deliberately maxed to sit above everything including 3rd-party widgets; console.css:49
dominant 'sit above sibling' utility inside cards/modals/dropdown triggers
e.g. operations/routes/edit.hbs manually orders 4 overlays in one file
mirrors informal code comments like 'Leaflet panes ~400-1000'

deadCode.note: A central z-index token utility exists but has zero callers anywhere in app/ — defined, never wired in. Candidate for either adoption or removal; flagged as a known quirk, not fixed here.

keyframes.name: lipu-boot-spin
keyframes.usedBy: boot spinner, animation: lipu-boot-spin 0.85s linear infinite (console.css:132)

keyframes.name: fadeIn
keyframes.usedBy: language selector dropdown, animation: fadeIn 0.15s ease-in-out (line 8)

prefersReducedMotion.note: Zero occurrences of 'prefers-reduced-motion' anywhere in console/. No motion-reduction path exists for any transition, keyframe, or animate-* utility, including the infinite boot-spinner and the ~55 animate-spin/animate-pulse usages.

customSvgSet.fullInventory: see icons.json for the full enumerated list with renderable SVG markup

fontAwesome.note: CORRECTED 2026-07-29: an earlier version of this file claimed FontAwesome was vestigial based on grepping the lowercase 'fa-icon' helper only, missing the <FaIcon> Glimmer component actually used everywhere including the sidebar. FontAwesome is the DOMINANT icon system by usage volume; the 48-icon custom inline-SVG set covers a narrower set of decorative/help/domain shapes. Full FontAwesome inventory (sidebar map, frequency table, all distinct names): see icons.json#fontAwesome.
